{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Code coverage

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - 'dependabot/**'
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "joss_paper/**"
      - "CITATION.cff"
      - "**/*.ipynb"
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "joss_paper/**"
      - "CITATION.cff"
      - "**/*.ipynb"

permissions: {}

jobs:
  Codecov:
    name: Code coverage
    if: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Install Ubuntu packages
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install cxxtest lcov
      - name: Checkout JSBSim
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure JSBSim
        run: |
          mkdir build && cd build
          cmake -DENABLE_COVERAGE=ON -DBUILD_PYTHON_MODULE=OFF -DBUILD_DOCS=OFF ..
      - name: Build JSBSim
        working-directory: build
        run: make --jobs=$(nproc)
      - name: Run JSBSim tests
        working-directory: build
        run: ctest -R Test1 --output-on-failure
      - name: Generate coverage report
        working-directory: build
        run: make lcov
      - name: Upload to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        with:
          files: ./build/lcov/data/capture/all_targets.info
          disable_search: true
          fail_ci_if_error: true",
  "rationale": "The repository CI history supplies representative successful-duration observations (about 2-3 minutes per run), which satisfies the precondition for P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout). That pattern is evidence-supported for reducing runaway job consumption, and its contraindication is not triggered because an explicit bound with headroom over observed valid runs will not cancel normal runs. Adding timeout-minutes: 30 bounds any stuck or runaway job without altering any build, test, or coverage step, so intended coverage is preserved. No permissions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access are added. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE was considered but is not cleanly applicable here: the dependency install is system-level apt (cxxtest/lcov) with no repository lockfile to key the cache on, and caching /var/cache/apt/archives on a hosted runner is not a safe minimal change.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
